text:
sophia: Seeing a sharp spike in 5xx/504s from hosted us-west-2 since ~14:20 PDT. p95 jumped to ~12s, p99 >30s. Grafana shows continuous-batcher queue_depth at 100% across multiple shards. Raising incident.

mike: Got it — any tenant IDs or patterns?

sophia: Two tenants: tenant_acme (high QPS) and tenant_juno (burst pattern). Acme accounts for ~60% of the backlog.

eng-sre-bot: [ALERT] continuous-batcher.queue_depth >= 1000 for shard{shard=3} (threshold 1000) — 14:22:11

lina: Logs look like dequeue latency spikes then request timeouts. Sample log: 
```
WARN batcher.dequeue 14:21:54 shard=3 wait_ms=18622 queue_depth=1001
ERROR gateway.handler 14:21:55 request_id=abcd1234 upstream=timeout status=504
```

omar: I see repeated client retries from tenant_juno — lots of identical payloads. Could be a retry loop causing snowballing.

mike: Can we repro with a curl from inside the hosted edge? Want to confirm gateway vs batcher.

sophia: Repro curl (from runbook):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.hosted.us-west-2.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

sophia: When I run that during spike I get 504 after ~30s. Gateway logs show downstream ENOTREADY / request queue full.

lina: Quick mitigation options: 1) route traffic for heavy tenants to cold capacity (if available), 2) increase continuous-batcher replicas, 3) enable prefix KV cache fallback for hot tenants. We should pick 1-2 fast mitigations.

mike: Agreed. Omar, can you validate if cold capacity has spare headroom? If yes, we can apply routing rule for tenant_acme -> cold-pool.

omar: Cold pools at 30% utilization. I'll flip a routing rule for acme to cold-pool (10s change window).

deploy-bot: starting: apply-routing-policy --tenant=tenant_acme --dest=cold-pool --timeout=10s (initiated by omar)

sophia: Also going to scale batcher replicas +2 for shards 2..4. Command: 
```
# temporary scale
kubectl -n hosted scale deploy/continuous-batcher-shard-2 --replicas=6
kubectl -n hosted scale deploy/continuous-batcher-shard-3 --replicas=6
kubectl -n hosted scale deploy/continuous-batcher-shard-4 --replicas=6
```

mike: Note — scaling helps capacity but will increase KV cache warmup time; prefer routing + cache fallback.

omar: Routing rule applied for tenant_acme -> cold-pool. monitor for 2m.

eng-sre-bot: [INFO] routing-policy.applied tenant=tenant_acme dest=cold-pool status=success 14:24:05

sophia: After routing + scale: queue_depth per shard dropped from 1000 -> ~430 in 45s. p95 back to ~350ms, p99 ~2.1s. Partial mitigation.

support-bot: Created support ticket #INC-2026 for tenant_juno and tenant_acme customer contacts. Notified CSMs.

lina: Root cause hypothesis: tenant_juno replay/retry loop (short auth TTL bug in their client) caused burst that pushed batcher into tail-saturation; batcher stopped batching efficiently and queued many small requests -> timeouts.

mike: Can we add a short-term rate-limit per-tenant at gateway to prevent queue saturation from single tenant? Proposal: soft limit 200 rps per tenant with rapid drop to cold-pool for excess.

omar: I can bake a temporary gateway policy and roll it 1 minute. Will coordinate with deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: starting: gateway-policy.create --name=soft-tenant-rate --limit=200rps --mode=redirect-to-cold (initiated by omar)

sophia: Policy live. Observing tail-latency further decrease, p99 approaching normal.

lina: Follow-ups: 1) Add tenant-level queue_depth alerting and auto-redirect after threshold 2) Update runbook with steps to scale batcher and route traffic 3) Work with customer success to confirm client changes to backoff/retry logic.

mike: Agreed. Also schedule postmortem to confirm whether kernel-level queue limits or batcher concurrency knobs need adjustment.

omar: One more data point: batcher metrics show batch sizes collapsed from avg 18 tokens -> 3 tokens during the spike (inefficient). That matches the small-request retry hypothesis.

sophia: Closing incident as mitigated -> leaving this thread open for postmortem notes. If anything resurfaces re-open. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Ticket INC-2026 updated: mitigation applied, customers notified, follow-up scheduled.

mike: Thx all — great quick ops. We'll file a short RCA and action items.
